messages:
Jordan Tran: Hey folks — I'm starting Monday as an AE. Quick setup help? Need CRM seat, Dialpad, Gong, access to the AE playbook + collateral, and the onboarding call playlists. Who should I ping for each?
Maria Chen: Congrats Jordan! I'll kick off CRM + Gong. Can you confirm your work email for SSO? Also tell me if you need edit or view access to collateral.
Jordan Tran: Thanks Maria — jtran@redwood.ai. View + edit on playbook would be helpful for notes.
Ben Alvarez: Welcome aboard! Added a note to your ramp doc. Maria: please assign "AE" role in CRM (no admin). Also please request Dialpad seat. @Provisioning Bot FYI.
Provisioning Bot: Ticket #PRV-2247 opened for CRM + Dialpad + Gong provisioning. Estimated completion: 24 hours.
Maria Chen: Gong invite sent to jtran@redwood.ai — check spam if you don't see it.
Jordan Tran: Got the Gong invite, thanks. Dialpad still pending. Any quick tips for voicemail/greeting setup?
Ryan Patel: I'll drop the playbook and call templates here. Use the "AE-Outbound" template for your first-week cadences. Playbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/playbooks/ae-outbound
Ryan Patel: Quick voicemail setup: Settings > Voicemail > Upload greeting. For script, use the "New AE Intro" snippet in the playbook.
Jordan Tran: Also need CRM view of target accounts and Gong playlists for onboarding calls — can someone grant those?
Maria Chen: CRM path is Sales > Pipelines > AE Onboard — I'll add you to that view. Gong playlists: Ben, could you share which playlist to follow?
Ben Alvarez: Sharing playlist "AE New Hire - Calls" now. Also added you to #ae-ramp Slack channel and granted access to the shared collateral folder.
Jordan Tran: Perfect. Will review the playlist and scripts tonight. One last q: will I get the latest pitch deck and battlecards?
Ryan Patel: Yep — pitch deck + battlecards in the collateral folder. I'll DM you a 1-pager with top objections and counters. :rocket:
Jordan Tran: Awesome, appreciate it. Tagging this thread to reference during ramp. Will follow up if anything else pops up.
Provisioning Bot: Update: CRM and Dialpad seats provisioned, Gong confirmed. Ticket #PRV-2247 closed. :white_check_mark:
